records.title: IESS-FusionNet: Physiologically Inspired EEG-EMG Fusion with Linear Recurrent Attention for Infantile Epileptic Spasms Syndrome Detection
records.reason: IESS-FusionNet detects epileptic spasms from EEG/EMG. Its real-time signal-processing goal is outside LLM inference and the linked lineages.

records.title: Dynamic Subspace Composition: Efficient Adaptation via Contractive Basis Expansion
records.reason: DSC approximates context-dependent adapter weights using a shared sparse basis and claims O(Md) parameter and O(Kd) memory-traffic scaling versus retrieving independent LoRA experts. On a single T4 it reports language-model/perplexity comparisons and reduced routing latency penalties relative to MoE. It is an adaptation/training method, with no decode-time serving results.

records.title: SagaScale: A Realistic, Scalable, and High-Quality Long-Context Benchmark Built from Full-Length Novels
records.reason: SagaScale provides a long-novel benchmark with very long contexts and evaluates frontier LLMs. It is a benchmark contribution, not an inference optimization.

records.title: When Does Learning Renormalize? Sufficient Conditions for Power Law Spectral Dynamics
records.reason: This paper develops theoretical conditions for power-law spectral dynamics during learning. It does not present an inference or serving optimization.

records.title: Mitigating Negative Transfer in Continual Test-Time Adaptation Via Orthogonal Dual-Path Mixture of LoRa Experts
records.reason: IEEE DOI https://doi.org/10.1109/ICVRV67992.2025.00097 could not be opened. Abstract describes continual test-time adaptation using dual-path LoRA experts, but full-text evaluation and inference-cost effects could not be checked.
